grammar.purpose: Describe how an action is performed
grammar.explanation: 笑得很开心 describes the manner of laughing; it does not establish permission to tease. A 得 complement follows the verb. Keep the example’s degree distinct from how many times an action occurred.

examples.py: tā xiào dé hěn kāi xīn .
yīn yuè xiǎng dé tīng bù qīng huà .
examples.en: The music is so loud that speech cannot be heard.

examples.py: wǒ shuō dé tài kuài le .

commonMistakes.why: Put the degree complement after the verb and 得.

grammar.pattern: 一点儿也 / 都 + 不 / 没
grammar.explanation: 一点儿也不生气 emphasizes no anger; it does not mean a little angry. 一点儿也没听懂 emphasizes lack of understanding of the specified material. Do not substitute this for merely 没完全听懂.

examples.py: tā yì diǎn ér yě bù shēng qì .
examples.en: She is not angry at all.

examples.zh: 这一句我一点儿也没听懂。
examples.py: zhè yī jù wǒ yì diǎn ér yě méi tīng dǒng .
examples.en: I did not understand this sentence at all.

examples.py: wǒ yì diǎn ér dōu bù xiǎng chǎo jià .
examples.en: I do not want to quarrel at all.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一点儿也不生气是有点儿生气。
commonMistakes.right: 一点儿也不生气是完全不生气。
commonMistakes.why: The negation is emphatic, not a small positive degree.

dialogue.title: Tea and teasing
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find whether the friend is actually comfortable.

lines.zh: 你笑得这么开心，是在笑我吗？
lines.py: nǐ xiào dé zhè me kāi xīn , shì zài xiào wǒ ma ?
lines.en: You are laughing so happily; are you laughing at me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，我只是想到那个传说。对不起，让你误会了。
lines.py: bù shì , wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng dào nà gè chuán shuō . duì bù qǐ , ràng nǐ wù huì le .
lines.en: No, I only thought of that legend. Sorry for the misunderstanding.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这杯奶茶超级甜。你怎么还说香极了？
lines.py: zhè bēi nǎi chá chāo jí tián . nǐ zěn me hái shuō xiāng jí le ?
lines.en: This milk tea is extremely sweet. Why call it so fragrant?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 香和甜不同。你选绿茶，我少放糖。
lines.py: xiāng hé tián bù tóng . nǐ xuǎn lǜ chá , wǒ shǎo fàng táng .
lines.en: Fragrance and sweetness differ. You choose green tea; I use less sugar.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门外不断传来笑声。据说她们吵架了。
lines.py: mén wài bù duàn chuán lái xiào shēng . jù shuō tā men chǎo jià le .
lines.en: Laughter keeps coming through. Reportedly they quarrelled.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问本人，也可能是在演。我一点儿都不想乱猜。
lines.py: xiān wèn běn rén , yě kě néng shì zài yǎn . wǒ yì diǎn ér dōu bù xiǎng luàn cāi .
lines.en: Ask them; they may be acting. I do not want to guess at all.
lines.speaker: b

reading.purpose: Read the note about a welcoming activity.

lines.zh: 新朋友来了，大家热烈欢迎，她笑得很开心。
lines.py: xīn péng you lái le , dà jiā rè liè huān yíng , tā xiào dé hěn kāi xīn .
lines.en: A new friend arrives and receives a warm welcome; she laughs happily.

lines.zh: 她迷这部剧，回答充满笑意，但没有替任何人回答。
lines.py: tā mí zhè bù jù , huí dá chōng mǎn xiào yì , dàn méi yǒu tì rèn hé rén huí dá .
lines.en: She loves this series and answers with amusement but speaks for nobody else.

lines.zh: 这个现象不代表所有人都喜欢同样的玩笑，参与的积极性也不是完成次数。
lines.py: zhè gè xiàn xiàng bù dài biǎo suǒ yǒu rén dōu xǐ huān tóng yàng de wán xiào , cān yù de jī jí xìng yě bù shì wán chéng cì shù .
lines.en: This phenomenon does not mean everyone likes the same joke; enthusiasm is not a completion count.

lines.zh: 桌上有点儿乱，玩具上的白毛掉在旁边，牌子先放正。
lines.py: zhuō shàng yǒu diǎn ér luàn , wán jù shàng de bái máo diào zài páng biān , pái zi xiān fàng zhèng .
lines.en: The table is a little messy; a white toy hair fell beside it; straighten the sign first.

lines.zh: 真巧，我们都选绿茶。茶很好，就是有点儿凉。
lines.py: zhēn qiǎo , wǒ men dōu xuǎn lǜ chá . chá hěn hǎo , jiù shì yǒu diǎn ér liáng .
lines.en: What a coincidence: we both choose green tea. It is good, but a little cool.

lines.zh: 她一点儿也不生气，不等于下次不用问；据说的事先确认。
lines.py: tā yì diǎn ér yě bù shēng qì , bù děng yú xià cì bù yòng wèn ; jù shuō de shì xiān què rèn .
lines.en: She is not angry at all, but we should still ask next time; confirm reported information.
